LESSON: HOUSE OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.1: House of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about House of God. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is the church a holy place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,
2. participate in church activities to grow spiritually,
3. appreciate the church as a house of worship. The learner is guided to: from the Bible text, mentioned in the Bible text, house of God, Why is the church a holy place?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. participate in church activities to grow spiritually,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to participate in church activities to grow spiritually,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the church as a house of worship. The learner is guided to: from the Bible text, mentioned in the Bible text, house of God, Why is the church a holy place?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the church as a house of worship. The learner is guided to: from the Bible text, mentioned in the Bible text, house of God, Why is the church a holy place?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about House of God.
2. Explain House of God to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read Matthew 21:12-13 and list lessons learnt from the Bible text,
4. Show that you can: outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about House of God. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is the church a holy place?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Matthew 21:12-13 and list lessons learnt from the Bible text,
2. Read 1Corithinians 14:26 and list activities mentioned in the Bible text,
3. In groups, list the activities they do in church,
4. In pairs, list ways of respecting the church as a house of God,
5. Sing a song related to serving God.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,
2. participate in church activities to grow spiritually,
3. appreciate the church as a house of worship. The learner is guided to: from the Bible text, mentioned in the Bible text, house of God, Why is the church a holy place?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
